resources.string: Your mosque\'s adhan and iqamah times from Masjidbox, with the next prayer highlighted
Pick a mosque you\'ve used, or type a new one: the part after masjidbox.com/prayer-times/ in its link, or paste the whole link.
Pick a colour. \"Phone theme\" follows your wallpaper colours.
Only used when the mosque\'s web page lists adhan times but not iqamah (e.g. Chingford Mosque).
Lets the highlight and countdown switch over exactly at each adhan and iqamah. Without it, Android may update the widget a few minutes late.

To add a widget: long-press an empty space on your home screen, tap Widgets, find Iqama Times and drag it on. Make it one row high for just the times, or two rows for the countdown banner. Tap a widget to change its mosque. You can add several widgets for different mosques.
